title: Scenarios: processes to draw as well
intro: Under the runs a list of the processes of Fig. 1 of the Daisy paper can be ticked, or described in words. Daisy then writes the logs these figures need.

marks.d: Weather, snow, canopy, soil water, biopores, drains, heat and ice, nitrate, ammonium, organic matter, carbon, denitrification, photosynthesis and crop growth.
Write for example snow and soil temperature in winter; the matching processes are ticked.
Runs the simulations and draws the standard figures and these.
